summary: WebRender, Firefox’s GPU compositor, is being reorganized around clearer coordinate systems for rasterization, visibility, clipping, and compositing. The work improves pixel snapping, image sizing, shadows, filters, and tile culling while simplifying clip tracking and making GPU device and shader interfaces less dependent on raw OpenGL details. New scene inspection and context-menu tools also make it easier to diagnose rendering problems; _these are mainly reliability and maintainability improvements rather than visible UI changes_.
